body:
Source: release review of v1.11.1..main. Re-verified at HEAD: five repo scripts guard their CLI entry with a hand-built URL, `import.meta.url === \`file://${process.argv[1]}\``: scripts/block-secret-exposure.mjs:133, scripts/scan-findings-ledger.mjs:73, scripts/guard-findings-ledger-append-only.mjs:128, scripts/ceremony-drift.mjs:782 and apps/docs/scripts/check-links.mjs:50. import.meta.url is percent-encoded (a space becomes %20) while argv[1] is the raw path, so from a checkout whose path contains a space (or any Windows path) the comparison is false and each script exits 0 having run nothing. For the PreToolUse secret-exposure hook (.claude/settings.json) empty stdout with exit 0 is an allow, so a command that traces a secrets file into the transcript runs unchecked. For scan-findings-ledger and guard-findings-ledger-append-only, which `npm run preflight` runs as gates, local preflight reports them green without running them (guard-findings-ledger-append-only with no argument exits 0 instead of printing usage and exiting 1). ceremony-drift skips main() and exits 0 instead of the exit 1 its own exit-code contract requires for a broken reporter. CI runner paths contain no space, so CI itself is unaffected.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. The settled entry-guard shape is in plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs and scripts/preflight.mjs: `Boolean(process.argv[1]) && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href`, with pathToFileURL from node:url. Tests: `node --test scripts/test/<file>` from the worktree root. A spaced-path subprocess test copies the script under `<tmp>/a b/` with node_modules and packages symlinked in (realpath the tmp dir first; a symlinked tmpdir masks the defect). Temp dirs must be bound to a name and removed in t.after (scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs).

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Every listed script compares import.meta.url against pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href, guarded by Boolean(process.argv[1]) so importing the module never throws.
2. Run from a path containing a space, each script produces the output only its CLI entry produces: the secret-exposure hook prints a deny decision for a violating payload; scan-findings-ledger exits non-zero on a malformed ledger; guard-findings-ledger-append-only with no argument prints usage and exits 1; ceremony-drift in a directory with no ticket store prints `ceremony-drift: could not compute drift` and exits 1; check-links with no argument prints usage and exits 1.
3. The deliberate fail-open of the secret-exposure hook on malformed hook input is unchanged; failing open because of the install path is not part of it.
4. A repo guard fails if any .mjs under scripts/ or apps/docs/scripts/ reintroduces the hand-built `file://` + argv[1] guard outside a comment.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 The secret-exposure hook denies a violating payload when run from a path containing a space. verify: `node --test scripts/test/entry-guard-space-path.test.mjs`
- AC2 scan-findings-ledger, guard-findings-ledger-append-only, ceremony-drift and check-links run their CLI entry from a path containing a space. verify: `node --test scripts/test/entry-guard-space-path.test.mjs`
- AC3 No script under scripts/ or apps/docs/scripts/ builds its entry-guard URL by hand, and the detector is shown to bite. verify: `node --test scripts/test/entry-guard-space-path.test.mjs`
- AC4 Existing suites for the touched scripts and the fixture-boundary guard stay green. verify: `node --test scripts/test/block-secret-exposure.test.mjs scripts/test/scan-findings-ledger.test.mjs scripts/test/guard-findings-ledger-append-only.test.mjs scripts/test/ceremony-drift.test.mjs scripts/test/ceremony-drift-exit.test.mjs scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`
- AC5 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0
- Each changed script's own test runs it as a program (no arguments: it does its job) and imports it from an inline module (argv[1] undefined: no throw, no CLI run), so an argv-index change to the entry guard fails that test. verify: `node --test scripts/test/scan-findings-ledger.test.mjs scripts/test/guard-findings-ledger-append-only.test.mjs scripts/test/ceremony-drift.test.mjs apps/docs/test/check-links.test.mjs`

OUT OF SCOPE: entry guards under packages/ and plugins/; any change to what the five scripts check once they run; CI workflow changes.
title: scripts: run CLI entry guards correctly from checkout paths containing a space
